expectations.name: 01-page-written
expectations.text: Record 0001, the session-store decision, is changed: the map edits a changed decision in place, keeping its number.

expectations.name: 02-structure
expectations.text:
Each page the agent wrote or changed meets the map's structural rules: a declared kind, listed in its guide, links
and anchors that resolve, the kind's sections in order, a record named NNNN-<slug>.md, no rejected synonym.

expectations.name: 03-lead
expectations.text: The record opens with a lead under its title, not a restatement of the title.

expectations.name: 04-reason-told
expectations.text:
The record's Context tells what happened, the sessions table filling the database disk during Saturday pickup and
what it cost, before it states a conclusion such as "the session store did not scale".
expectations.evidence: The Context states: “Nothing ever deleted an expired session from that table” and records “2.1 million rows,” the Saturday disk failure, downtime “from 09:40 to 12:50, during pickup,” volunteers using a paper list, and eleven members leaving without their orders. It then names the forces: “a deploy must log no one out” and volunteers keeping services and jobs down, before the options and decision.

expectations.name: 05-fact-stated
expectations.text: The record keeps the previous choice, Postgres, under Options, and its Decision names signed cookies.
expectations.evidence: match /## Options\s.*Postgres.*## Decision\s.*cookie/ in ['docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-signed-cookies.md']: {'docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-signed-cookies.md': '## Options\n\n- **Sticky sessions at the load balancer**: no code change; lost in 2023 because a deploy still logs out eve'}

expectations.name: 06-trap
expectations.text:
No second decision record is added: the map edits a changed decision in place instead of superseding it with a new
record.
